scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.description: Hub-timeline forward simulation with inferred transmission and disease parameters and default contact / load / mobility settings from the scenario ``hub_timeline`` block.
scenarios.technical_explanation: The hub-timeline kernel (``eosp.services.hub_timeline``) runs a calendar-anchored Monte Carlo: negative-binomial contact draws at hubs (μ_travel / μ_stay / onset burst from ``hub_timeline.contacts``), load-dependent transmission via ``load.alpha`` on effective infectious weight L, and Markov hub mobility (``mobility``). Posterior means for p_transmit, h2h_multiplier, cfr, incubation feed per-trajectory draws. Contact volumes are explicit in ``hub_timeline.contacts``, not scaled by inferred ``contacts_daily``. ``parameter_overrides`` and ``network_modifications`` are empty — no extra scaling.

scenarios.name: terminal_distancing
scenarios.similar_to: Social distancing in airports and crowded travel settings.
scenarios.description: Reduces hub crowding pressure by tightening the load response (same narrative as weaker terminal mixing).
scenarios.technical_explanation: ``network_modifications.modify_weights.itinerary_patch`` (0.62) multiplies ``alpha_load`` in ``_scenario_config`` (ensemble), weakening how aggregate infectious weight L raises per-contact infection risk — analogous to softer mixing without changing inferred p_transmit or contact Poisson-means unless ``parameter_overrides`` add them. Mobility and dispersion keys match baseline unless overridden.

scenarios.name: reduced_travel_connectivity
scenarios.similar_to: Lighter travel and fewer effective connections.
scenarios.description: Explicitly lower hub contact Poisson means and slightly tighter mobility in ``hub_timeline`` to represent lighter travel (same narrative as the old contacts_daily scale).
scenarios.technical_explanation: Contact means and load are set in ``hub_timeline`` (μ values preserve the former 1.75 / 4.0 scale vs baseline as an explicit scenario choice, not an inferred posterior side effect). Network graph for hub mobility still comes from OpenFlights routes.

scenarios.name: enhanced_case_isolation
scenarios.similar_to: Stricter isolation when cases are identified.
scenarios.description: Scales inferred transmissibility downward for the hub contact draw infection step.
scenarios.technical_explanation: ``parameter_overrides.p_transmit_scale`` (0.45) adjusts the mean ``p_transmit`` via ``ScenarioSpec.apply_to_parameters`` before truncated-normal draws inside each trajectory — fewer successful transmissions given the same L and contacts. Hub graph, NB dispersion ``r_dispersion``, and mobility block default to baseline.
